name: Lark
self_text: Hi! I'm Lark, an Italian guy in my mid 30s. When I'm not gaming on my handheld, I love watching old westerns for the classic atmosphere. I mainly play Tidewatch, where I usually queue for casual matches and play a support role. I'm also happy to coach. I am generally free on Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Tidewatch and casual matches, and you have to be available on either Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon. It would be nice if you play a damage role or are flexible about your role, and it's a small bonus if you are the one who gets coached by me.
